## Article: Parag Parikh Flexi Cap vs Mirae Asset Large & Midcap: 5-Year Rolling Return Analysis
Canonical URL: https://yieldnest.online/article/parag-parikh-flexi-cap-vs-mirae-asset-large-midcap

### Executive Summary: The Allocation Dilemma
For retail and HNI investors constructing a core equity mutual fund portfolio in India, two flagship schemes consistently occupy center stage: Parag Parikh Flexi Cap Fund and Mirae Asset Large & Midcap Fund. While both have delivered remarkable compound annual growth rates (CAGR) over the preceding decade, their underlying risk architecture, portfolio construction methodologies, and factor bets diverge substantially.

This quantitative research paper examines their risk-adjusted performance, downside capture ratios, portfolio overlap, and expense drag utilizing official datasets from the Association of Mutual Funds in India (AMFI).

Core Research Finding: While Mirae Asset captures cyclical upswings with aggressive mid-cap participation, Parag Parikh's disciplined value orientation, selective cash buffers, and foreign equity exposure generate superior risk-adjusted alpha with 34% lower drawdown volatility during market turbulence.

## Article: Small Cap Mutual Funds Stress Test: Liquidity Risk, Days-to-Liquidate & Market Resilience
Canonical URL: https://yieldnest.online/article/small-cap-mutual-funds-stress-test-sebi-amfi-liquidity

### Executive Summary: The Liquidity Reality of Small Caps
Following rapid retail inflows into Indian small-cap funds, SEBI mandated liquidity stress tests published monthly by AMFI. This research examines portfolio liquidity horizons for Nippon India Small Cap, Quant Small Cap, and HDFC Small Cap Funds.

Core Research Finding: Days-to-liquidate metrics reflect portfolio concentration and free-float constraints. Investors must balance trailing momentum with stress test liquidation horizons to manage panic redemption risks during market corrections.

## Article: NIFTY 50 Index Funds vs Active Large-Cap Funds: Is Alpha Dead in Indian Equities?
Canonical URL: https://yieldnest.online/article/nifty-50-index-funds-vs-active-large-cap-funds

### Executive Summary: The SPIVA India Reality
The SPIVA India scorecard shows that over 85% of actively managed large-cap mutual funds fail to outperform the NIFTY 50 TRI benchmark over 5 and 10-year investment horizons once fees and transaction frictions are accounted for.

Core Research Finding: For pure large-cap exposure, low-cost index funds with tracking errors under 0.05% provide mathematically superior expected compounding compared to high-expense active funds.

## Article: Direct vs Regular Mutual Funds: The Compounding Drag of Distributor Commissions & Total Expense Ratios
Canonical URL: https://yieldnest.online/article/direct-vs-regular-mutual-funds-charges-commissions-compounding

### Executive Summary: The Invisible Cost of Intermediation
A 0.85% difference in Total Expense Ratio (TER) between Direct and Regular plans reduces terminal wealth by over ₹47 Lakhs on a 20-year monthly SIP of ₹25,000 at a 12% baseline return.

Core Research Finding: Direct plans hold identical underlying stocks and fund management teams. Transitioning to Direct plans is the single highest-certainty return enhancement available to mutual fund investors.

---

## Article: How to Measure Mutual Fund Performance: Rolling Returns, Alpha, Beta & Risk-Adjusted Ratios
Canonical URL: https://yieldnest.online/article/evaluating-mutual-fund-performance-rolling-returns-risk-ratios

### Executive Summary: Beyond Trailing CAGR Point-to-Point Bias
Trailing returns suffer from severe endpoint distortion. Quantitative fund evaluation requires analyzing daily 3-year and 5-year rolling returns, Sortino ratios, Sharpe ratios, and downside capture percentages.

Core Research Finding: Consistency of outperformance across rolling windows correlates far higher with future alpha than trailing 1-year performance rankings.

## Article: AMFI & Regulatory Guidelines: Categorization Norms, Liquidity Mandates & Riskometer Framework
Canonical URL: https://yieldnest.online/article/amfi-latest-regulatory-updates-categorization-norms-transparency

### Executive Summary: Investor Protection Architecture in India
SEBI and AMFI circulars govern scheme classification, portfolio disclosure schedules, dynamic monthly riskometers, and mandatory stress testing to protect retail investors.

Core Research Finding: Understanding regulatory mandates ensures investors avoid style drift, excessive small-cap exposure in multi-cap schemes, and illiquid debt paper.

## Article: Why TER Matters: Impact of Expense Ratio on Mutual Fund Returns
Canonical URL: https://yieldnest.online/article/why-total-expense-ratio-ter-is-important-for-investors

### Executive Summary: The Hidden Compounding Drain
When evaluating mutual funds, investors frequently focus almost exclusively on past trailing returns and fund manager star ratings. However, one of the most mathematically reliable determinants of your long-term terminal wealth is the Total Expense Ratio (TER). A 1% TER difference drains over ₹41 Lakhs on a 20-year monthly SIP of ₹25,000.

Core Research Finding: Direct plans hold identical underlying stocks and fund management teams as Regular plans. Transitioning to Direct plans eliminates distributor commissions and immediately enhances terminal compounding.

## Article: Quant Small Cap vs Nippon India Small Cap: A Data-Driven Analysis
Canonical URL: https://yieldnest.online/article/quant-small-cap-vs-nippon-india-small-cap-comparison

### Executive Summary: Two Opposing Philosophies in Small Cap Investing
In the volatile landscape of Indian small caps, Quant Small Cap uses proprietary quantitative VLRT factor momentum and high portfolio turnover, while Nippon India Small Cap relies on deep institutional bottom-up diversification with 150+ stocks.

Core Research Finding: Nippon India provides superior drawdown cushioning and lower beta during broad market corrections, whereas Quant delivers explosive factor-driven upside during momentum expansions. Both require strict risk management under AMFI liquidity stress test horizons.
